title: The Clock That Called the Rain
story: The village clock had been silent for years. When drought cracked the fields, a child named Pim climbed the tower. He found a blue gear that did not match the others. A note in the dust said to turn it once if the sky forgot. Pim turned the gear. The clock chimed, and clouds gathered over the hills. Rain fell before he reached the square. People set out buckets and laughed. The oldest farmer told Pim the clock was a bargain with the river spirit. It would ring only when someone asked kindly. Pim oiled the gear and closed the tower door. That night the streets shone.
